name: Bone Crow
text: Feast 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, add 1 to its attack value for the remainder of the turn if it is targeting a card with any wound tokens on it.

name: Calamity Golem
text: Rancor: When this unit is declared as an attacker, deal damage to a target unit an opponent controls equal to the number of wound tokens on this unit.

name: Summon Bone Crow
text: [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[ceremonial:class]]: If a unit was destroyed this turn, place a [[Bone Crow]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Calamity Golem
text: Destroy an ally you control to place a [[Calamity Golem]] conjuration onto your battlefield. Place wound tokens on it equal to the printed recover value of the destroyed ally.
